findings.conclusion: No direct reply edge is admissible within these packets. All 40 unique records are Darwin outgoing letters addressed to W. B. Tegetmeier; no incoming Tegetmeier source survives in either packet.
findings.details: The existing first passes correctly leave proposed_prompt_ids empty, but their generic no-pair wording hides the decisive authorship check. Darwin outgoing records can describe receipt of Tegetmeier material or answer an unlocated note, but cannot themselves be paired as incoming prompts. Same-correspondent chronology is evidence for missing inputs only.

evidence.quote: I write one line to thank you very sincerely for the card for the Philo-peristeron
your most kind offer of buying for me old Cocks at Stephens
Your letter has been forwarded here.

findings.conclusion: Several outgoing letters preserve acknowledgements, requests, receipts, offers and forwarding reports that point to absent Tegetmeier inputs; these are not reconstructed prompts.
findings.details: Examples include 1813 thanking a card, 1820 answering an offer to buy old cocks, 1842 requesting distinctive birds, 1882 acknowledging safely received eggs, 1947 acknowledging the Victoria Runt while scheduling Scanderoons, and 1955 reporting a forwarded letter. The surviving Darwin paragraphs establish only the cited event or response scope. Do not manufacture the contents of the absent card, offers, chart, or notes.

evidence.quote: I write one line to thank you very sincerely for the card for the Philo-peristeron
I have received the eggs safely & put them under a Hen
I received the Victoria Runt all safe & fresh
Your letter has been forwarded here.

findings.conclusion: The later sequences in batches 27–28 are not reply edges among the Darwin records.
findings.details: 1955, 1957 and 2068 are each Darwin-to-Tegetmeier records, as are 1975–2173. Shared poultry topics, adjacent dates, “your letter” language, or successive shipments cannot establish an incoming-to-Darwin endpoint. Preserve any reference to a received item as knowledge or receipt evidence with the item itself absent.

evidence.quote: In accordance with your kind offer, I write to say that what I want far most of all is one or two good Carriers
Very many thanks for the Catalogue just received
It shall be at Carstangs on Thursday morning

findings.conclusion: Preserve XML date bounds and editorial alternatives rather than assigning exact dates from sequence.
findings.details: 1913 is bounded 1–31 July 1856 and 1935 is bounded 15–22 August 1856. The remaining records have single XML days, but those are bracketed editorial dates and do not establish dispatch or receipt. Keep composition, dispatch, receipt and later editorial date layers distinct.

findings.conclusion: Partial Darwin responses and logistics preserve only their explicit subject scope; receipt or forwarding does not identify the missing cover.
findings.details: 1943 asks for a London delivery address for two Scanderoons; 1947 states the Victoria Runt arrived and schedules a separate shipment. 2093 says a note was mislaid, while 2115 says the Poultry Book has not yet been read. These are independent receipt/reading states, not evidence for one recoverable prompt.

evidence.quote: I received the Victoria Runt all safe & fresh
I know I have your note, (but I have mislaid it)
I have not begun yet to read Poultry Book

findings.conclusion: No source-specific inline figures, MathML, or body tables were found across the 40 packet/context records; four image nodes per page are site chrome and must not be treated as letter figures.
findings.details: The body prose includes raw transcription artifacts such as “diag” and “ramme” in places, but no actual figure asset is present for these packets. Preserve exclusions and apparatus separately from body paragraphs. Existing evidence locators use body blocks and should remain scoped to those blocks.

notes: Full target and context bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, apparatus, scholarly material and bibliography were checked against the preserved packet scope. Exact quote evidence was selected from loaded body paragraphs and paired with actual unique raw HTML DOM paths; quote validation is run separately below. All conclusions retain missing-input, source-voice and date/receipt boundaries.
